visualCharacteristics.structure: ingredients list + tools list + numbered steps + step images

variants.contentPattern: 1 row x 2 columns. Cell 1: H3 'Ingredients' + unordered list (quantity + ingredient, product links preserved). Cell 2: H3 'You'll Need' + unordered list of tools; H3 'Directions' + ordered list where each item holds step text followed by the step image. The section heading, yield, and times sit in default content before the block.

1 row x 2 columns. Cell 1: H3 'Nutrition Facts'; paragraphs 'Servings Per Container 24', 'Serving size 1 brownie (69g)', 'Calories 290'; list of nutrient lines 'Total Fat 14g 18%' ... 'Potassium 142mg 4%'; footnote paragraph. Cell 2: H4 'Additional questions?' + link 'Contact Customer Service'.
